WHY TRUEPATH

Built to be used, not to be checked.

TruePath started from a simple frustration. Most of the apps that claim to help you grow are, in practice, built to hold your attention for as long as possible, pulling you back in with streaks, notifications, and gamified pressure that has very little to do with your actual wellbeing. We wanted something quieter instead, a tool that genuinely helps you show up for yourself, gives you an honest picture of how you are really doing, and then steps out of the way so you can go live your life instead of staring at another screen.

Most apps

WHO IT'S FOR

Made for people who'd rather do the work than perform it.

The habit rebuilder

Starting over after falling off track, and wants a simple way to stay honest about it.

The quiet reflector

Processes life by writing it down, not by talking it out, and wants a private place to do that.

The goal-chaser

Has a direction in mind and wants to see, day by day, whether their actions actually match it.

YOUR DATA

Everything stays on your device.

TruePath runs entirely in your browser. There's no server collecting your habits, moods, or reflections in the background.

Nothing sent to a server

Your habits, mood logs, and reflections are stored locally in your browser, not on a remote database.

Nothing sold, ever

There is no ad network and no data broker involved anywhere in how TruePath works. We deliberately avoided building a business model that depends on collecting, packaging, or selling information about you, because that kind of incentive tends to shape a product in ways that work against the very person using it.

Yours to clear anytime

If you ever clear your browser data, everything TruePath has stored disappears right along with it, because there is no separate copy of your information sitting on a server somewhere else. Whatever stays on your own device is the only copy that exists, which means you remain fully in control of it at every point in time.

WHAT'S NEXT

Still growing, out in the open.

The items on this roadmap should be read as directions we are leaning toward rather than promises we are locking ourselves into, since priorities can and often do shift as TruePath grows and as we learn more from the people actually using it day to day.

QUESTIONS

A few things people ask.

Is TruePath free to use?
Yes, and that is not going to change anytime soon. There are no paid plans, no subscriptions, and no premium tiers hiding behind a paywall, because TruePath is built from the ground up to be completely free to use for everyone, starting from the very first day you open it.
Do I need to create an account?
Signing in creates a session in your own browser so your dashboard is there when you come back. It isn't tied to a server-side account system.
Where is my data stored?
Locally, in your browser. Nothing is transmitted to a server or third party.
Can I lose my data?
Since everything lives in your browser, clearing your browser data or switching devices will reset TruePath. It's worth keeping that in mind.
Will TruePath ever show ads?
No. TruePath isn't built as a business, so there's no advertising or monetization built into it.
